currentObservations.title: 云业务收入与利润率指标同步提升
currentObservations.summary: Google Cloud Q2 收入同比增长82%，同期运营利润率从去年同期20.7%升至35.6%。该阶段性指标组合显示，当前云业务变化不仅体现为收入规模扩大，也伴随利润率指标改善。
currentObservations.strategic_implication: 该观察补充了已有收入与订单规模观察，新增同一对象盈利能力变化维度；收入增长与运营利润率提升来自不同证据来源，形成同对象相关指标信号。

evidence_cards.source_quote: Google Cloud Q2 Revenue Soars 82%, Backlog Jumps 390%
云业务运营利润率也从去年同期的20.7%升至35.6%

currentObservations.title: 云业务增长与订单储备规模均显示扩张态势
currentObservations.summary: 2026 Q2 Google Cloud 实现收入247.7亿美元，同比增长82%；同期披露的订单积压达到5140亿美元，另有来源显示 backlog 跳增390%。这些指标共同表明，当前 Google Cloud 的业务变化不仅体现在季度收入增长，也体现在已形成的大额订单承接规模。
currentObservations.strategic_implication: 新增观察同时结合收入规模变化与订单积压变化，补充了 Google Cloud 当前经营状态中“需求承接规模扩大”的理解，且非单一指标或单一来源。

evidence_cards.source_quote: Google Cloud Q2 Revenue Soars 82%, Backlog Jumps 390%
二季度谷歌云实现收入 247.7 亿美元，同比增长 82%

facts.subject: android_60_developer_compliance_delay
facts.statement: After Google granted developers a flexible window to update apps under Android 6.0, many developers used that flexibility to delay compliance for months and continued gathering user data until Google imposed consequences such as lower search rankings and reduced visibility in its app store.
facts.effective_period: Android 6.0 post-rollout window studied in Management Science paper

evidence_cards.source_quote: Developers were granted a flexible window to update their apps. Many used that flexibility to delay compliance for months, continuing to gather user data until Google imposed consequences such as lower search rankings and reduced visibility in its app store.

item.html:
• Christopher Nguyen claimed fine-tuned Gemma variants outperform larger proprietary models on domain-specific tasks.
  • Gemma is positioned for on-site/local deployment of industrial AI agents after fine-tuning.
  • Google's Gemma models are open-weight models.
  • Yann LeCun endorsed Google's Gemma open-weight models as the go-to foundation for fine-tuned, site-deployed industrial AI agents.
  • ATLAS 报告样本覆盖 150 多个国家、140 种语言、800 种职业和 4000 个任务，来源于 Gemini 应用、搜索 AI Mode 及 Gemini API
  • 超过 86% 的 AI 交互发生在工作之外
  • 非例行认知任务在整体经济任务中的占比为 35%
  • 非例行认知工作（如分析、创意设计）占职场 AI 交互的 65%
  • 完全自动化任务的交互占比不足 10%
  • 在使用 AI 的职业岗位典型任务中，仅约 20% 调用 AI
